reason: I'd probably grab the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge, but YouTube with a 30-minute timer already does the job for me, so when day 14 comes I'd just stay on the free version or go back to YouTube. I've never paid for a sleep app and 4,900 won a month for sleep sounds doesn't feel necessary.
objection: YouTube sleep music is free and my timer works fine. If I wake up I just hit play again, so the 'resume where it stopped' thing isn't worth a monthly fee to me.
would_change_my_mind: If my own 14-day record showed I was actually falling asleep a lot faster, like 15+ minutes quicker than with YouTube, I might pay for the yearly plan.
